title: Is PS5 Pro Worth It for GTA 6? Still 30 FPS: Our Verdict
desc: No 60 FPS: GTA 6 runs at 30 FPS on PS5 Pro too, and Rockstar says no performance mode before PC. What the Pro adds, its 2 TB storage, and who should buy one.
lede: Short answer: the PS5 Pro is the best place to play GTA 6, but it doesn't get you 60 FPS. Every console runs the game at 30 FPS. Here's what the Pro changes, based on Digital Foundry's testing. Updated Nov 26: Rockstar says no 60 FPS mode is coming to consoles before a PC version.
sections: Rockstar confirmed a 30 FPS target, and there's no performance mode on PS5, PS5 Pro or Xbox Series X|S.

• A sharper image with PSSR upscaling.
  • Ray-traced shadows.
  • Steadier performance: the base PS5 can dip into the low 20s in heavy action, according to Digital Foundry's testing.

• Buying a console for GTA 6 anyway: the Pro is the best version. See PS5 Pro (affiliate).
  • Already on a base PS5: the game is fully playable; the Pro is a nice-to-have, not a must. A storage upgrade (affiliate) may matter more for the 212 GB install.
  • On Xbox Series S: it's the weakest version, per the same testing; Series X or PS5 Pro look clearly better.
Consoles and bundles often drop on Black Friday (November 27, 2026). Our Black Friday page tracks what's worth it for GTA 6.
faq: Does GTA 6 run at 60 FPS on PS5 Pro?
No. GTA 6 runs at 30 FPS on every console, including PS5 Pro. Rockstar confirmed the 30 FPS target.

Yes. GTA 6 carries the PS5 Pro Enhanced label on the PlayStation Store, but the label doesn't mean 60 FPS: Rockstar targets 30 FPS on PS5 Pro too, with PSSR upscaling and extra ray-traced shadows. Rockstar hasn't said the exact resolution; the 4K claims come from leaked label rules, not from Rockstar.
Is GTA 6 better on PS5 Pro?
Yes: Digital Foundry's testing, as reported, found a sharper image with PSSR, ray-traced shadows and steadier performance than base PS5.
Which console is worst for GTA 6?
The Xbox Series S struggles the most, according to the same Digital Foundry testing.
Will GTA 6 get a 60 FPS patch on PS5 Pro?

Not planned. On November 18, Rockstar's technology production director told Kotaku that the PS5 Pro's CPU can't run GTA 6's simulation at 60 FPS and that a performance mode isn't coming before a PC version (as reported by HotHardware and Notebookcheck). Earlier rumors of a 60 FPS update never came true.
Do you need a PS5 Pro to play GTA 6?
No. GTA 6 runs at 30 FPS on the regular PS5 and Xbox Series X|S too. The PS5 Pro adds sharper PSSR upscaling and ray-traced shadows, not a higher frame rate.
Does the PS5 Pro have enough storage for GTA 6?

Yes for most people. The PS5 Pro has a 2 TB SSD (about 1.89 TB usable), and GTA 6 is reportedly about 210 GB. You'd only add an M.2 SSD if your game library already fills the drive; our PS5 SSD guide explains Sony's requirements.
